sources.title: Claude Opus \ Anthropic
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 is a strong agentic coding model built for long-running, multi-step work. It deeply understands your codebase, holds the thread across complex tasks, and pins down requirements for feature development and bug-fixing more effectively than Opus 4.8.

sources.title: Claude 5 Opus — AI Model | MindStudio
sources.snippet: Claude 5 Opus is a large language model developed by Anthropic, released in July 2026. It supports a one-million-token context window and can generate responses up to 128,000 tokens in length, making it suited for tasks that involve long documents, extended conversations, or multi-step reasoning across large bodies of text.
